releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.GoogleCloudOASIS v2.0.5

WEB4 OASIS API GoogleCloudOASIS Provider is one of the many WEB2/WEB3 providers that plug in and integtate into the OASIS.

What's new since v2.0.4
- Add anonymous Google Cloud metadata CQL with native three-record proof (623d6e3)
- Align Firestore ID reads with tombstone visibility contract (aff0616)
- Align Firestore native holon deletion projection with canonical state (3d732c7)
- Align Google detail selectors with canonical case-insensitive identity (079aaaf)
- Bind Firestore acknowledgement counts and reconcile null Oracle writes (cc941f6)
- Classify persisted cloud JSON corruption at shared storage boundary (388ccb4)
- Correct Google activation credentials and resource error handling (3027747)
- Correct Google metadata All and Any collection matching (7b22f3c)
- Correct GoogleCloud returned read counts with retained Firestore proof (8ff89e4)
- Delete Google avatar and detail together in native transaction (924754e)
- Distinguish inactive Firestore avatars from committed tombstones (1ffe111)
- Enable native-verified Firestore historical data queries (3a184cc)
- Enroll isolated Google CQL read profiles with explicit permission and pricing (06e7aec)
- feat(firestore): atomically commit conditional graphs and durable operation receipts (823aada)
- feat(firestore): export all validated stored record versions (76ff67f)
- feat(firestore): retain protected write preparations with native operation fencing (7609a16)
- Fence uncertain Google detail write attempts from V2 replay (85ff037)
- Fix Firestore deleted avatar detail visibility with native verification (a4bfe85)
- Fix Firestore root visibility for inactive records and tombstones (dce8eb2)
- Fix Google holon provider-key reads to use stored document identity (6098054)
- Fix Google nearby partial-coordinate integrity and type validation (93bb628)
- fix: expose cloud capabilities for Cosmos Firestore and BigQuery (82d92cc)
- fix(cloud): implement Azure and Firestore avatar token lookups (10b69b2)
- fix(cloud): reject ambiguous Azure and Firestore wallet keys (143193d)
- fix(firestore): publish committed provider revisions after ordinary batch saves (8fbbd08)
- fix(firestore): remove invented aggregate request padding (a2cf885)
- fix(firestore): retain planned roles in conditional history writer (b4cf93e)
- fix(firestore): validate scalar document size before native writes (e9f1a60)
- fix(google): acknowledge paired lifecycle writes through one transaction owner (59022ae)
- fix(google): canonicalize trusted inputs and persist detail provider keys (994f08c)
- fix(google): decouple export root versions from avatar history (453d0e5)
- fix(google): enforce depth limits from parent-query selection (8396657)
- fix(google): guard related identity lifecycle in single-attempt transactions (573427a)
- fix(google): own canonical search scope before Firestore reads (992b913)
- fix(google): prevent tombstone resurrection in canonical saves (3582b8c)
- fix(google): prune foreign descendants from scoped graph reads (56745c8)
- fix(google): reject disabled-service activation and verify boot configuration (076fb68)
- fix(google): reject invalid holon types before storage access (d2d055d)
- fix(google): reject misleading credential-based storage overloads (a957bae)
- fix(google): report conditional entity acknowledgements and lifecycle conflicts (3d41215)
- fix(google): require authoritative Firestore save timestamps (2fd3938)
- fix(google): select avatar export roots by creator (65c25c5)
- fix(google): validate collection identity before historical selection (b3c6b3c)
- fix(google): validate native holon delete acknowledgements (dfcf119)
- fix(providers): reuse exact JSON objects in DynamoDB and Firestore history (d1e1459)
- fix(providers): share validated conditional acknowledgement assembly (b88181d)
- fix(storage): scope historical embedded graph exports by owner (0422e00)
- Guard acknowledged Google and AWS record publication with shared identity checks (b37ad59)
- Honor Google holon collection filters and graph options (4ae298a)
- Honor Google single holon child graph read options (3ed265e)
